policy: Product capability debt tracks intentionally deferred completeness work. It is separate from native QUALIFICATION_DEBT.json and must not be interpreted as a qualification result.

items.capability: Broader automated official OEM/component driver authorities
items.reason: Phase 18.1 intentionally models many providers as ManualOfficial/official utility rather than fabricating unsupported direct adapters.
items.completionTruth: Do not claim world-wide automated driver coverage until each additional official authority has an implemented, security-qualified provider path.

items.capability: Additional structured DNS/DHCP/proxy/Winsock native collectors and narrowly supported repair authorities
items.reason: Phase 19 models these domains and safety rules but deliberately does not ship broad reset/tweak fallbacks where authoritative root-cause evidence is unavailable.
items.completionTruth: Add only supported typed providers/actions with native proof; never convert this debt into a generic network reset.

items.capability: Broader official repair-reinstall/WinRE guided integration across Windows versions
items.reason: Availability and safety differ by Windows version/configuration; destructive recovery remains guided rather than silently automated.
items.completionTruth: Detect supported official paths per machine and retain Level 4/5 consent/data-safety boundaries.

items.capability: Performance Intelligence, bottleneck analysis and safe optimization engine
items.completionTruth: Keep performance symptoms separate from Windows corruption/repair findings.

items.capability: Full Timeline Intelligence UX and recurrence reasoning
items.reason: Phase 19 persists structured repair events but intentionally does not build the full timeline product yet.
items.completionTruth: Future timeline consumes issue/repair/reboot/verification/recurrence/escalation events without rewriting their historical truth.

items.capability: Whole-PC one-click orchestration across safe auto and user-approved domains
items.reason: Phase 19 explicitly rejects RunEveryRepairCommand and only builds diagnosis-linked sealed repair plans.
items.completionTruth: Future orchestration may run only SAFE_AUTO plus explicitly approved dependent actions under shared mutation/recovery policy.
